request: mix: .envの重複キー・全角文字・末尾空白を報告する / .envファイルを読み（省略時は標準入力）、不正なキー名、重複キー、引用符なし値の末尾空白、値に混じった全角文字や全角空白、閉じていない引用符を行ごとに「行番号: 内容」で報告する。値の文字数と表示幅の食い違いを根拠に全角を検出する。問題があれば終了コード1。例: 「NAME=太郎 」の行は「1: 全角文字と末尾空白」と出る。コマンド名は envchk

spec.name: envchk
spec.summary: envchk checks a .env file (or stdin) line by line for invalid keys, duplicate keys, trailing spaces, full-width characters and unclosed quotes.
behavior: B1: At most one positional argument is allowed. With none, read stdin; with one, read that file. More than one argument prints 'envchk: usage: envchk [file]' to stderr and exits 2. If the file cannot be read, print 'envchk: ' followed by the error text to stderr and exit 1.

B2: Split input on newline; strip one trailing carriage return from each line. Line numbers start at 1. A line that is empty or whitespace only, or whose first non-space/tab character is '#', is skipped (it still counts for numbering). Empty input prints nothing and exits 0.

B3: For other lines, remove leading spaces/tabs, then remove a leading 'export ' if present. Split at the first '='; key is the text before it, value the text after it. If there is no '=', the whole text is the key and the value is empty.
B4: Problem 不正なキー名: the key does not match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (an empty key is invalid).
B5: Problem 重複キー: the key is valid and was already seen on an earlier line. Only valid keys are recorded as seen.

B6: Problem 全角文字: take the value, remove all ASCII characters (code points below 0x80); if the remainder's display width (github.com/mattn/go-runewidth StringWidth, with DefaultCondition.EastAsianWidth set to false) differs from its rune count, the problem applies. Applies to quoted and unquoted values alike.
B7: Problem 末尾空白: the value does not start with ' or " and ends with an ASCII space or tab. Values starting with a quote never get this problem.
B8: Problem 閉じていない引用符: the value starts with ' or " and the same quote character does not appear again anywhere later in the value.

B9: All problems of a line are collected in this fixed order: 不正なキー名, 重複キー, 全角文字, 末尾空白, 閉じていない引用符. If there is at least one, print to stdout 'N: ' followed by the names joined with 'と', then a newline. Example: 1: 全角文字と末尾空白.
B10: Exit 0 if no problem line was printed; exit 1 if at least one was printed.

cases.name: clean
cases.stdin:
A=1
B="x y"
# c

export C=3

stdout.exact:
1: 不正なキー名
2: 不正なキー名

cases.name: file with fullwidth space and quoted trailing

stdout.exact:
1: 全角文字
3: 末尾空白
